zh: 请出示您的护照和登机牌。
en: Please show your passport and {boarding pass}.

zh: 我只带了一个随身行李包。
en: I only have one {carry-on bag|carry-on|cabin bag}.

zh: 我买了一张去基督城的往返票。
en: I bought a {return ticket|round-trip ticket} to Christchurch.

zh: 我想要一个靠窗的座位。
en: I'd like a {window seat}, please.

zh: 我们在候机厅等了两个小时。
en: We waited in the {departure lounge|departures lounge} for two hours.

zh: 你可以在行李提取处取你的箱子。
en: You can pick up your suitcase at {baggage claim|baggage reclaim}.

zh: 出国前别忘了买旅行保险。
en: Don't forget to get {travel insurance} before you go overseas.

zh: 飞机晚点了，所以我没赶上转机航班。
en: The plane was late, so I missed my {connecting flight|connection}.

zh: 租车需要出示驾照。
en: You need to show your {driver's licence|driver's license|driver licence|driving licence|driving license} to hire a car.

zh: 我们在机场取了租来的车。
en: We picked up our {rental car|hire car} at the airport.

zh: 我不开车，所以靠公共交通出行。
en: I don't drive, so I rely on {public transport|public transportation}.

zh: 高峰时段路上堵得很厉害。
en: The roads are packed during {rush hour|peak hour}.

zh: 我遇上堵车了，要晚到一会儿。
en: I'm stuck in a {traffic jam}, so I'll be a bit late.

zh: 最近的公交车站在哪儿？
en: Where's the nearest {bus stop}?

zh: 我们打算今年夏天去南岛自驾游。
en: We're planning a {road trip} around the South Island this summer.

zh: 值机柜台在起飞前一小时关闭。
en: The {check-in counter|check-in desk} closes an hour before departure.

zh: 我回来一个星期了，时差还没倒过来。
en: I've been back a week and I've still got {jet lag}.

zh: 过护照检查的地方排了很长的队。
en: There was a long queue at {passport control|immigration|border control}.

zh: 我的箱子太重了，只好付超重行李费。
en: My suitcase was too heavy, so I had to pay for {excess baggage|excess luggage}.

zh: 我更喜欢靠过道的座位，起身方便。
en: I prefer an {aisle seat} so I can get up easily.

zh: 我们去怀赫科岛玩了一天，当天来回。
en: We did a {day trip} to Waiheke Island.

zh: 霍比特村是新西兰最热门的旅游景点之一。
en: Hobbiton is one of New Zealand's most popular {tourist attractions|tourist spots|attractions}.

zh: 上高速之前我们先找个加油站吧。
en: Let's find a {petrol station|service station|gas station} before we get on the motorway.

zh: 这条路的限速是五十。
en: The {speed limit} on this road is fifty.

zh: 我们不赶时间，走风景好的那条路线吧。
en: We're not in a hurry, so let's take the {scenic route}.

zh: 奥克兰到上海有直飞航班吗？
en: Is there a {direct flight|non-stop flight|nonstop flight} from Auckland to Shanghai?

zh: 我们住在湖边的一个假日公园（露营地）。
en: We stayed at a {holiday park|camping ground|campground|campsite} by the lake.

zh: 停车场已经满了。
en: The {car park|carpark|parking lot} is already full.

zh: 我沿着自行车道骑车上班。
en: I cycle to work along the {cycle lane|bike lane|cycleway|cycle path|bike path}.

zh: 去机场最便宜的办法是坐机场大巴。
en: The cheapest way to get to the airport is the {airport bus|airport shuttle}.
